# TypePlot browser runtime

Built from [typeshade/typeplot](https://github.com/typeshade/typeplot/tree/2d343d2f6423ea6db03f0c7a5c6b9f5c90a3f927) at runtime source commit `2d343d2f6423ea6db03f0c7a5c6b9f5c90a3f927`.

Run the library build and examples generation, then `npm run sync:typeplot` in website/.
JavaScript is generated and ignored by Git. Declarations, source provenance, Apache-2.0 LICENSE,
and NOTICE are retained. Compiled power, sine, helix and surface programs come from the repository's named
TypeShade callbacks. The website does not compile visitor source or load a CDN runtime.
